steps.note: Cover: spawn and walk to the belt; a Golden Jazz Macaroni Fish is walking past your base with the cash counter ticking.
Buy: stand next to a walking brainrot on the belt and press E (BrainrotInteract) to buy it and carry it home.
Steal / lock: walk into a rival's unlocked base, press E to steal their brainrot, then press Q (BrainrotLock) to lock your own base for 45s.
Event: wait for the 90-second event timer; the Noodle Tsunami / Giggle Storm sweeps the map while you carry a brainrot home.
